item.title: Goodbye to Nick Brown.
item.description: It’s always a sad time when a presenter moves on but after 200 episodes of Milestone Jazz, Nick has decided to pull the pin. We wish Nick all the best for the future and his continuing support of Community Radio up at Mt Beauty.

item.title: Welcome to Ross Williamson and his mates.
item.description: Ross and his mates are taking over the vacated time slot on Mondays with a show called Hot Sweet and Jazzy. We welcome the newbies to the station and wish them well for the future. Join in on Mondays at 8.30 pm to hear this new Jazz programme.

item.title: Albury Wodonga Community Radio Celebrates 40 Years.
item.description: While recent event’s may have called off the physical celebrations, there are at least 40 reason’s why staff at one of the country’s earliest community stations are rejoicing. 2020 marks the historic year that is, the 40th anniversary of the Community Radio Albury Wodonga Cooperative Society Ltd. item.title: Changes to programs
item.description: 2REM would like you the listeners to know that Dad and Dave have now moved for the summer. Starting at 12:05pm and repeated at 5:35pm, Tuesdays to Fridays. Also please note that some of your programs have been altered as well. For all information regarding programs, please refer to our program guide.

item.title: Best wishes for your retirement, Elko & Ingrid!
item.description: Thank you Elko & Ingrid (Neviandt). It is with much sorrow that we accepted your resignation due to ill health from 2REM.
